name: TartanAir: AirSim-Based Visual SLAM and Depth Estimation Dataset
description: TartanAir is a massive photo-realistic synthetic dataset for visual SLAM, optical flow, and depth estimation collected in simulated environments using Microsoft AirSim. Curated by Carnegie Mellon University, it features 1,000 diverse simulated drone trajectories spanning over 3 million frames across 30 diverse photo-realistic indoor and outdoor scenes with ground truth stereo RGB, depth, optical flow, surface normals, and camera poses.
